name: GridCsvExportOptions
description: The options to apply on the CSV export.

entries.name: allColumns
entries.description: If `true`, the hidden columns will also be exported.

entries.name: delimiter
entries.description: The character used to separate fields.

entries.name: escapeFormulas
entries.description:
If `false`, the formulas in the cells will not be escaped.
It is not recommended to disable this option as it exposes the user to potential CSV injection attacks.
See https://owasp.org/www-community/attacks/CSV_Injection for more information.

entries.name: fields
entries.description:
The columns exported.
This should only be used if you want to restrict the columns exports.

entries.name: fileName
entries.description: The string used as the file name.

entries.name: getRowsToExport
entries.description: Function that returns the list of row ids to export on the order they should be exported.

tags.returns: The list of row ids to export.

entries.name: includeColumnGroupsHeaders
entries.description: If `true`, the CSV will include the column groups.

tags.see: See {@link https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/column-groups/ column groups docs} for more details.

entries.name: includeHeaders
entries.description:
If `true`, the CSV will include the column headers and column groups.
Use `includeColumnGroupsHeaders` to control whether the column groups are included.

entries.name: utf8WithBom
entries.description:
If `true`, the UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (BOM) prefixes the exported file.
This can allow Excel to automatically detect file encoding as UTF-8.
